Package eu.algites.lib.data.smartdataobject.xmldefs

Interface AIiXmlSmartDataObject

All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.data.dataobject.AIiDataObject, AIiSmartDataObject, eu.algites.lib.common.validation.AIiValidatable<AIiSdoValidationIssue>, eu.algites.lib.data.dataobject.xmldefs.AIiXmlDataObject
public interface AIiXmlSmartDataObject extends AIiSmartDataObject, eu.algites.lib.data.dataobject.xmldefs.AIiXmlDataObject
Mutable SmartDataObject contract for data originating from XML Schema.

This is an interface composition, not a concrete runtime implementation. Generated mutable contracts extend this marker together with their generated read-only contract. The shared SmartDataObject API supplies presence, effective values, validation and mapping operations; the technology marker preserves the definition family for schema-aware consumers. A concrete implementation may derive from the common SmartDataObject base class and implement the generated mutable interface, without format-specific runtime registration.
